title: J.D. LaRock:
title_short: J.D. · Most People Don't Take Action
headline: An entrepreneurial mindset is simple: see the problem, then do something about it.
story: Alison asked for J.D.'s answer to one question: what does an entrepreneurial mindset look like in real life? His answer is short and strong. It is a person who can solve problems and feel sure they can figure things out. Most people see a problem, understand it, and do nothing.
Open on the sharpest line, then let him define it, then land on the action. It must feel clear, confident and hopeful. This is J.D. as a national voice, not a man at home.

Hide jump cuts with small punch-ins (110% or less).
Let "That is it." land. Keep his small pause.
End on his face, then the end card.
dont: No logo, title card or fade at 0:00.
No city or home location on screen.
Don't use 15:01–15:06. He starts the sentence twice.

bp_intro: All source times are in 20260624_C4258.MP4 (31:49, one camera, J.D. only). Times come from the transcript word times and are accurate to about 0.2 s. Find exact in and out points on the waveform. Every frame is from the real file. The yellow box shows the 9:16 crop.

rows.frame_alt: J.D. speaking to the lens, grey quarter-zip, striped tie, bookshelf behind
rows.visual: J.D. mid-sentence, looking into the lens. Bookshelf behind, lamp on the left, window on the right. Crop centred on his face.
rows.motion: Hook text on frame 1, top third: MOST PEOPLE DON'T TAKE ACTION. White, bold, "ACTION" in NFTE orange #FF5C39. Cut on, no animation longer than 6 frames.

voice.quote: The main problem with most people is just that they don't take action.

rows.music: Light, optimistic bed starts low under his voice.

rows.visual: Same framing. Hard cut back in time. Small punch-in (105%) to hide the jump. Keep his pause before "That's it. That is it."
rows.motion: Hook text out at 00:04. Name super 00:04–00:06, small, lower left: "Dr. J.D. LaRock" / "CEO, Network for Teaching Entrepreneurship (NFTE)". Then out.

voice.quote: Fundamentally, an entrepreneurial mindset in real life looks like a person who can solve their problems and feel confident that when something happens, they can figure out what to do. That's it. That is it.

rows.frame_alt: J.D. speaking, hands low in front of him
rows.visual: Back to 100%. Cut the first word "But".
rows.motion: Captions only. Colour "90%" in NFTE orange.

voice.quote: even advancing a wrong answer is better than what 90% of people do, which is to look at the problem, to understand the problem, and to do nothing about the problem.

rows.frame_alt: J.D. raises his right hand as he speaks
rows.visual: He lifts his right hand on "I have power within me". Move the crop a little right so the hand stays in. Punch-in 105%.
rows.motion: Captions only. Colour "take action" in NFTE orange.

voice.quote: The entrepreneurial mindset says, I see the problem, I understand the problem, and I have power within me to create a solution of some kind and to take action.

rows.music: Small lift on "take action". Not a swell.

rows.frame_alt: J.D. finishing his answer to the lens
rows.visual: Back to 100%, centred. Hold 0.5 s on his face after "don't do".

voice.quote: That is powerful, it is simple, and it is something most people don't do.

rows.visual: The NFTE end card from the delivered J.D. LaRock reels.
rows.music: Last note rings out. 1 s fade.
